verdict: All paid channels are dark; organic visibility is now declining too.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, there was zero paid spend and zero paid leads — no Meta or Google Ads campaigns were active for Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, or O'Hare Precision. The combined 376 Google Business Profile actions (105, 93, and 178 respectively) represent the only inbound activity your businesses received in the last 28 days. That organic floor is now also weakening: GBP actions fell week-over-week at all three locations, and search clicks dropped sharply at Forte Metals (–60%) and O'Hare Precision (–51%), with both sites recording zero search clicks over the last three to four days. We are investigating the Forte Metals listing immediately, as the pattern of a hard stop across both GBP and search clicks points to a listing-level issue that requires urgent resolution; organic performance across all locations is being monitored closely while paid reactivation is planned.

watch_item.fix: The listing is being reviewed and actioned this week to restore visibility as quickly as possible.
